//: Vault's Vercel project builds from the REPO ROOT, so this file is its config — unlike PathFinder and Protocol, which each have their own under apps/. That is why the ignoreCommand was missing here: it was added to the two app-level files and this one was overlooked, so Vault rebuilt on every push to every branch, including PRs that never touched it. On a Hobby plan that is a third of the build quota spent on nothing.
ignoreCommand: if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && npx --yes turbo@^2 query affected --base=$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA --packages vault --exit-code; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi
